name: ANSI/IEEE maintained normally-closed pushbutton symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for maintained normally-closed pushbutton, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The non-auto-return NC pushbutton form identifies a contact that is closed in its reference state and retained after the operator changes it. The release or reset description determines when continuity is restored.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace the circuit's permissive state through the retained operation.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A retained NC operator is not automatically an emergency-stop device.
